messages:
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Canary in ap-northeast1 for embed-service showing sustained 9.7% 5xx and a spike in p95. Automated pause fired (threshold 8%). Requesting expedited decision: pin to stable image or abort rollout.

cory: Copy. Is it widespread or single-instance noise?

deploybot: Impact: ~1.2% of user traffic saw errors, but error clusters correlate with customers on long-sequence requests. Logs: tokenization exceptions in quant path.

liz: We should pin. Customers are seeing bad vectors. Ops, can you escort a pin to v1.2.8-stable?

amh: +1 from infra. If we pin, we should block new canary deployments and keep artifacts for debugging.

ops_oncall: I can run the pin and monitor. Standard watch 20m. If errors don't drop below 1% we escalate. Who will run the command?

cory: Running the pin now:
```
/releasebot pin --service embed-service --to-image redwood/embed:v1.2.8-stable --reason "canary regressions v1.2.9" --owner cory --urgency expedited --hold-artifacts true
```

releasebot: Pin request received. Verifying image sig, ACLs, and policy... OK. Applying traffic pin and preventing new canary rollouts. ETA ~30s.

deploybot: Traffic reroute complete. All user traffic now on redwood/embed:v1.2.8-stable. v1.2.9 canaries scaled to zero. Canary artifacts preserved at gs://redwood-canaries/3276543210/ for debug.

liz: Drafting release note snippet: "Pinned to v1.2.8 due to canary regressions in v1.2.9 (quant tokenization). Artifacts saved for investigation. Postmortem owner: cory." Will link once published.

amh: I'll create a short ticket to capture infra-level diffs and kernel flags used during build.

ops_oncall: Monitoring: error_rate dropped to baseline ~0.4%, p95 back to normal. Holding for 20m. Will escalate if any metric spikes.

cory: Started debug: reproducing quant tokenization on preserved canary artifacts. Initial suspicion: a changed default in a transitive dependency.

liz: Tagging security/compliance for awareness given customer impact. No PII involved but want record.

ops_oncall: +22m stable, no further spikes. Closing expedite window. Marking thread resolved. Please attach postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:

cory: Will follow up with root-cause and mitigations doc in the release tracker.
